title: pydantic-ai
summary: Pydantic-AI is a comprehensive framework for building, running, and managing intelligent AI agents. It provides core agent logic, integrates with various language models and embedding services, and offers extensive tool management and extensible capabilities. The framework also supports durable workflow integrations for robust, fault-tolerant agent deployments. It includes UI components for interactive applications and evaluation tools for performance assessment.

nodes.label: Developer / User
nodes.title: Human User / Developer
nodes.description: Interacts with the Pydantic AI framework to build, run, and evaluate AI agents and applications.

nodes.label: Core Agent Logic
nodes.title: Agent Core Module
nodes.description: Defines the foundational architecture for AI agents, managing their execution flow, model interactions, output handling, and configuration.

nodes.label: AI Models & Embeddings
nodes.title: Models and Embeddings Module
nodes.description: Provides interfaces and implementations for various large language models (LLMs) and text embedding services, abstracting provider-specific details.

nodes.label: Agent Tools & Capabilities
nodes.title: Tools and Capabilities Module
nodes.description: Manages the discovery, execution, and lifecycle of tools and extensible capabilities that enhance an agent's functionality and interaction with external systems.

nodes.label: Durable Workflow Integrations
nodes.title: Durable Integrations Module
nodes.description: Offers integrations with workflow orchestration systems (e.g., DBOS, Prefect, Temporal) to ensure AI agents are durable, fault-tolerant, and recoverable.

nodes.label: UI & Utility Components
nodes.title: UI and Utility Module
nodes.description: Contains general-purpose utilities for asynchronous operations, concurrency, data formatting, and adapters for various user interfaces and communication protocols.

nodes.label: Evaluation Framework
nodes.title: Evaluation Module
nodes.description: Provides a comprehensive framework for evaluating AI agent and function performance, encompassing online evaluation, dataset generation, diverse evaluator types, and robust reporting and telemetry.

nodes.label: Graph Engine
nodes.title: Graph Engine Module
nodes.description: Provides a robust framework for defining, executing, persisting, and visualizing complex directed acyclic graphs (DAGs) or state machines, enabling structured workflow orchestration.

nodes.label: Utilities & Documentation
nodes.title: Utilities & Documentation Module
nodes.description: Provides general-purpose utilities, command-line tools, and documentation generation enhancements, including scripts for testing and cloud service verification, alongside custom MkDocs hooks.

groups.label: Actors
groups.title: External Actors
groups.description: Represents the human users or developers interacting with the Pydantic AI system.

groups.label: Core AI Framework
groups.title: Foundational AI Building Blocks
groups.description: These modules provide the essential intelligence, model interaction, and functional extensions required for building and operating AI agents.

groups.label: Orchestration & Resilience
groups.title: Workflow Orchestration & Durability
groups.description: Ensures the reliability, recoverability, and structured execution of AI agent operations through robust workflow systems and graph-based orchestration.

groups.label: Interfaces & Support
groups.title: User Interfaces, Evaluation & Utilities
groups.description: This group handles user-facing interactions, performance evaluation, general system utilities, and documentation support for the entire framework.
